youtube.title: Called 'human cockfighting'. Valued at $12.1B. Who paid?
youtube.description: In 1993 the UFC was eight fighters in a cage with almost no rules, and a senator called it 'human cockfighting'. Bought for 2 million dollars in 2001, sold for about 4 billion in 2016, valued at 12.1 billion in 2023, while fighters' estimated share is about a fifth of revenue. Facts checked against Wikipedia (UFC, UFC 1, Zuffa, TKO Group Holdings); primary sources were not accessible.

tiktok.caption: Bought for 2 million dollars in 2001, valued at 12.1 billion in 2023. Fighters' estimated share: about a fifth of revenue. Fair? You decide.

publish.note: Hashtags vor dem Posten in Creator Search Insights / YouTube-Suche gegenprüfen. Alle Belege tertiär (Wikipedia, docs/quellen-ufc.md); Primärprüfung von Zahlen (Z14, Z26, Z31, Z33–Z36, Z40) laut Drehbuch-Faktencheck noch ausstehend. '12.1B' = Bewertung bei WWE-Fusion 2023, nicht Verkaufspreis. Reichweite der Hashtags unbelegt. Prüfung 13.11.2026: Titel 'a $12.1B UFC' → 'Valued at $12.1B' (Z31: "the merger agreement valued UFC at $12.1 billion" – Bewertung, kein Marktwert); Caption mit Jahren 2001/2023.
